_doc: The critic's verdicts, one entry per review: {id,date,verdict passe|doute|bloque,fr,en,checks}. Append to 'critiques'.

critiques.fr: Le gain de ce soir (+9 $ en 42 jours) est plus petit qu'un seul trade de rattrapage, et presque tout vient de la deuxième moitié. Sur 69 jours il perd 29 $ et creuse le plus gros trou de 15 $. Testé sans les protections, il perd 27 $ ; à quatre pertes de suite, 40 $. Il était à non cinq nuits sur huit. Pour changer d'avis : un gain sur 69 jours, plusieurs nuits de suite.
critiques.en: Tonight's gain (+$9 in 42 days) is smaller than one catch-up trade, and nearly all of it comes from the second half. Over 69 days it loses $29 and deepens the biggest hole by $15. Tested without the safety nets it loses $27; at four losses in a row, $40. It was a no five nights out of eight. To change my mind: a gain over 69 days, several nights running.
checks: dose: one step below (2 losses) is the deployed rule itself; harness (deployed rules, no safety nets): 3 losses -27.24 net, hole 80.29->95.37; 4 losses -40.41 net, hole ->94.68; 1 loss -30.69. Gain is not on a slope - only the deployed setting holds up
halves: battery ref +2.09 first half vs +13.72 second half - carried by the second half (a losing stretch where the extra catch-up happened to win). Harness: both halves worse (-19.58 / -8.63)
shapes: +9.14 on the uncapped reference, +3.50 on the capped one (account 1 shape), hole +0.38 / -0.65 - small on both
long window: 69 days -29.09, both halves negative (-13.5 / -13.67), hole +15.08 - a loss, not just weaker
real trades: +10.90 on 18 trades (5 blocked) - too few to outweigh the long window
concentration: +9.14 total < one single catch-up trade (catch-up wins/losses of 15-23 $ appear in the ledger, e.g. -22.32 in the second half) - one trade flipping explains it all

past: history C,C,C,C,C (worst 95.37 on 09-28/29, same as the no-safety-net run now) then B,B,A as recent days were added; not archived but already in the C counter, and three combos with it (rr10_k3, ext700_k3, nosun_ext700_k3) sit there too; no twin yet
mechanism: keeping a bigger stake after a third loss in a row only pays if the fourth trade wins more often than usual - no reason given beyond the numbers; it adds risk exactly in losing streaks
overlap: same trades as the deployed rule (258 vs 258, same win rate 61.2%) - only the stake on the trade after the third loss changes, so it is pure sizing on very few trades

critiques.fr: Avec toutes les protections, il gagne 3 $ en 42 jours, moins qu'un trade ; sur les vrais trades il perd 1 $. Sans protections, chaque trade de rattrapage en plus rapporte environ 22 $ mais creuse le plus gros trou d'environ 7 $ : c'est miser plus après une perte. Ce qui m'inquiète : le gain grandit avec le trou. Il était à oui une seule nuit sur douze.
critiques.en: With every safety net on, it gains $3 in 42 days, less than one trade; on the real trades it loses $1. Without the nets, each extra catch-up trade earns about $22 but deepens the biggest hole by about $7: it is just betting more after a loss. What worries me: the gain grows with the hole. It was a yes on only one night in twelve.
checks: dose (harness, deployed rules without safety nets, base 208.62 / hole 80.29): 2 catch-up -43.61 / hole 74.39; 4 catch-up +44.33 / hole 87.24; 5 catch-up +68.73 / hole 94.20. No sign flip - a clean slope, but money and hole rise together (~+22 $ and ~+7 $ hole per extra catch-up trade): a size lever, not a better rule. Archive agrees: 2 and 0 catch-up rejected (fewer = less money)

halves: battery ref +1.31 first half / +1.18 second half - tiny on both. Harness: +40.90 first half / +7.87 second half, but second-half hole 84.32->92.71 - the gain sits in the good first half, the extra depth in the bad second half
shapes: +2.94 on the uncapped account (hole -2.34 better), +1.45 on the capped one (hole -1.29) - same tiny size on both
long window: 69 days +37.70 (+15.87 / +13.37 by half) but hole +5.37 deeper -> C; a gain bought with depth, a caution not a no
real trades: -0.85 on 50 trades (9 blocked), hole +4.99 deeper - a small loss where it matters most
concentration: +2.94 under deployed rules is smaller than one average losing trade (-3 to -8 $ are common, -22.34 exists) - one trade flipping erases it
past: nightly history C,C,C,B,B,B,B,C,C,B,B,A - A only tonight; no twin yet; not archived (counter 0); several combos with it sit in the archive (rr09/rr10/k3 + 4 catch-up)
mechanism: a bigger stake after a loss pays only because the robot wins ~60% overall; it adds no edge, it adds stake exactly when the robot is in a losing streak
overlap: same trades as the deployed rule (265 vs 265, win rate 59.6% both) - only the stake on catch-up trades changes; pure sizing
real gap: --drag auto (~0.02 $/trade measured) leaves +30.19 raw vs base, hole 88.23 - survives the gap because it does not trade more, it bets more

critiques.fr: Ce soir il gagne 4 $ en 42 jours, moins qu'un seul trade de rattrapage. Sur 69 jours il perd 43 $, sur les deux moitiés. Testé sans les protections, il perd 48 $ : un trade de rattrapage en moins coûte environ 50 $ et ne réduit le plus gros trou que de 6 $. Il était à non onze nuits sur douze. Pour changer d'avis : un gain sur 69 jours, plusieurs nuits de suite.
critiques.en: Tonight it gains $4 in 42 days, less than one catch-up trade. Over 69 days it loses $43, in both halves. Tested without the safety nets it loses $48: one catch-up trade fewer costs about $50 and only makes the biggest hole $6 shallower. It was a no eleven nights out of twelve. To change my mind: a gain over 69 days, several nights running.
checks: dose (harness, deployed rules without safety nets, base 194.58 / hole 80.29): 1 catch-up 93.73 / 66.91; 2 catch-up 147.06 / 74.39 (-47.52, C); 4 catch-up 238.95 / 87.24. No sign flip but a clean slope the wrong way: each catch-up trade removed costs ~45-50 $ for ~6-7 $ of hole. Mirror of bul4 - a size lever, not a better rule
halves: battery ref +4.64 first half / +3.89 second half - tiny on both. Harness: -44.83 first half / -0.61 second half - the loss sits in the good half, the bad half is a wash

shapes: +3.65 on the uncapped reference (hole +0.32 deeper), +6.80 on the capped one (account 1 shape, hole -1.71) - both smaller than one trade; the gain only exists with the safety nets on (half lot when results fall), which already shrink catch-up stakes
long window: 69 days -43.19, both halves negative (-15.73 / -30.01), hole 5.90 shallower -> a loss, not a caution
real trades: +15.85 on 52 trades (10 blocked), hole 4.84 shallower - the one favourable sign, but 52 trades cannot outweigh 420 on the long window
concentration: +3.65 is smaller than a single catch-up trade in the ledger (-22.32, -19.12, +31.44 exist) - one trade flipping erases it
past: archived after three C nights in a row (-1 $ on the last); history C x11 then A tonight only; no twin; bul0 (no catch-up) also archived at -74 $

mechanism: a smaller stake after a loss means smaller holes and smaller recoveries; with the robot winning ~58% the recoveries outweigh the holes, so cutting them loses money - the only reason it scores tonight is the numbers
overlap: same trades as the deployed rule (274 vs 276, win rate 58.4 vs 58.3) - only the stake on the third catch-up trade changes; pure sizing
real gap: --drag auto leaves the harness result unchanged (147.06, -47.52 vs base); it trades 2 fewer, so a $1/trade charge would move it ~2 $ at most - not run, cannot rescue a -43 $ long window
